body:
⚠️ **Project-seat stub.** Job description: `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/ui.md`. This is **`domain:ui` seat 1**, the lane's first post on this board: objectui became this repository's `ui/` workspace (#25825), and the lane's former post lived on the objectui board, which this seat cannot reach. No `domain:ui` post existed in the `pm:seat` index here (open or closed) when this one was raised.

- **Current PM:** 🟢 `os-steve` · 由 os-steve 账户的项目负责 (the Claude Code project "objectstack", seat thread "接管 ui 车道派发") · `session_017iXjUm1rujwDk7f3KT1Pkk`, seated on the maintainer's word in that project (「你开始负责 ui 车道，并发10」, 2026-10-26T06:20Z). Mutex readings at seating: no prior `domain:ui` post, no open `pm:dispatched` card in the lane, no assignee on any open lane card.
- **Second seat:** `domain:ui` seat 2 = #25995 (maintainer's word, 2026-10-26). The split is by the fix's landing package. Seat 2 holds plugin-list / grid / detail / form / view / kanban / calendar / gantt / map / timeline / tree / charts / dashboard / report and `fields`. After the 09:18Z rebalance it also holds the auth pages (login / register / invitation), the app-shell Setup / admin pages, marketplace and the console sidebar. Seat 1 holds everything else: i18n packs, `components` (form.tsx), Studio / designer, AI chat and build, approvals, tech-debt. Cards on one file stay with one seat and land in order.
- **Hot-file serial queue:** `ui/.github/**` and the root `ci.yml` are ⛔ out of bounds for every ui card for now (the ui-merge `pm:epic` subtree under #25677 is editing them; maintainer's word in the project). **No sdui records** since #26367 merged at 2026-10-27 01:27Z: `scripts/sdui-manifest.sources/` is retired, and CI's `Build & E2E UI` regenerates `sdui.manifest.json` and compares bytes on the PR and on the queue's merge tree. A branch that still carries a record takes the modify/delete with `git rm`. A PR lands once it is green and its merge-tree is clean. Only a real source-file overlap serialises. Two PRs on the same function get a merged-tree build before arming. Current file overlaps: `RecordDetailView.tsx` #26384 (#26346) → #26402 (#25934; merge-tree clean, different functions) · `ObjectGrid.tsx` seat 2's #26341 → #26364 (#25994 slice 3) · `ObjectView.tsx` #25992 slices, one at a time.
- **In flight (2026-10-27T02:20Z):** in the merge queue or armed: #26346 (#26384) · #26348 (#26380, re-merging main after #26367). Arming on green: #26190 (#26363) · #25934 (#26402). Waiting on a file: #25994 slice 3 (#26364, `ObjectGrid.tsx` after seat 2's #26341). Building: #25992 slice 8. Held on the maintainer's ADR-0087 D8+D9 decision (#26220 parts 3–4): #25918 partial (#26293) · #25921 plugin-ai retirement (#26365; CI green except the two expected Check Changeset reds; the 25831 changeset line awaits the maintainer's confirmation). Needs the maintainer: #25922 split + designer strings. Two slots free: no ready seat 1 card (#25943 waits on a cloud card; #25915's remaining blocks need a components choice; #25950 and #26382 untriaged). Order rule (maintainer, 17:26Z): priority first across the lane. Landed since 10-26: #25858 · #25871 · #25872 · #25874 · #25877 · #25887 · #25888 · #25890 · #25892 · #25894 · #25897 · #25898 · #25899 · #25900 · #25901 · #25911 · #25917 · #25925 · #25938 · #25999 · #26126 · #26131 · #26172 · #26182 · #26183 · #26194 · #26199 · #26275 · #26276 · #26304 · #26306, plus #25915 slices 1–2, #25992 slices 1–7, #25994 slices 1–2, #25922 step 1 (#26219), #26220 parts 1–2 (#26319) and the #25921 dead-keys slice. Filed: #26131 · #26199 · #26220 · #26304 · #26306 · #26314 · #26347 · #26348 · #26382. Waiting on others: #25943 (cloud card).
